final: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost, AVG(derived_total_cost / product_price) AS ratio_avg FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio_avg) AS overall_avg FROM inv WHERE ratio_avg IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.avg_cost, inv.ratio_avg, inv.ratio_avg - overall.overall_avg AS diff FROM inv CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND inv.ratio_avg > overall.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_cost) AS avg_of_avg_cost, AVG(ratio_avg) AS avg_of_ratio_avg, AVG(diff) AS avg_of_diff FROM kept
